stem:
Kabir wants one isolated north pole from a bar magnet by snapping it in half.

What should he expect?

options.text: Each piece still has both a north and a south end.
One piece is a lone north pole with no south.
The red-painted half is always the only pole that exists.
Poles can be stored separately in two boxes.

teacher.key_rationale: A single pole cannot be separated. Each piece is still a magnet with two poles. Paint colour is not the test.
